messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT 2963004567 - Embeddings route /v1/embeddings showing elevated error-rate and CPU pressure. Error% 18% over 3m, p95 latency 2.3s.
Emma (SRE): I'm pulling dashboards. Top-of-stack looks like a few keys are generating huge batch throughput. Chat endpoints not seeing same spike.
Marta (prod-eng): Which API keys/customers? want to avoid global throttle if possible, prefer per-endpoint limits.
Emma (SRE): Top keys: key-81, key-77, key-13. Combined ~60% of current embeddings QPS. Suspect a vectorization job that wasn't rate-limited.
Sahil (oncall): Taking the handoff from Emma. Emma, propose concrete mitigations and I'll apply.
Emma (SRE): Emergency mitigation plan: 1) Immediate: soft per-key/per-route throttle for /v1/embeddings -> 5 rps per key (was 50) with 30s exponential backoff. 2) Route-priority: elevate /v1/chat over embeddings in scheduler. 3) For top offenders (key-81, key-77) enforce stricter limit 2 rps for now and notify their SEs. 4) If rerank backlog grows, temporarily increase rerank limit to drain. Post-incident: investigate batching settings and add quota safeguards.
Marta (prod-eng): SGTM. Also enable a global embeddings burst cap so control plane and autoscaler don't get overwhelmed.
Sahil (oncall): Applying step 1 via Console -> Rate Limits -> Create rule now.
OpsBot: rate_limit.create id=rl-2963a target=/v1/embeddings scope=api_key limit=5rps burst=10 enforcement=soft created_by=Sahil started_at=2963004625
Sahil (oncall): Pushing route scheduling change to favor chat requests; scheduler config updated to prefer chat tokens.
Emma (SRE): Snippet for runbook (copied to incident doc):
```
route: /v1/embeddings
scope: api_key
limit: 5 rps
burst: 10
enforcement: soft-429
meta: emergency temporary throttle
```
Product Support: Preparing customer comms for top affected accounts; will post status page update and email SEs.
OpsBot: added targeted limits: key-81 -> 2rps, key-77 -> 2rps, change_id=rl-2963b started_at=2963004680
Emma (SRE): After soft throttle: embeddings error-rate down 18% -> 6% within ~2m, p95 latency improved to ~1.1s. Good signal.
Sahil (oncall): Noticed rerank queue increased slightly; to prevent user-visible 429s on rerank clients, bump /v1/rerank to 10 rps per key for 20m. Will auto-revert.
OpsBot: rate_limit.update id=rl-2963c target=/v1/rerank scope=api_key limit=10rps burst=20 enforcement=soft created_by=Sahil started_at=2963004745
Marta (prod-eng): Set automated rollback timers: rerank bump -> 20m, embeddings throttle -> review at 30m. Add alert to revert if embeddings metrics stable.
Sahil (oncall): Automated timers set. Alert rule: reopen if embeddings error% > 8% OR p95 > 1.8s.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied. Customer impact: degraded embeddings throughput for noisy customers (targeted 429s). Chat routes unaffected. Incident ticket INC-2963 created.
Product Support: Status page and emails sent to top-10 affected customers; SEs tagged for outreach to key-81/key-77.
Emma (SRE): I'll stay on watch for another 10m then hand off to Sahil fully. If host CPU climbs again, escalate to infra.
Sahil (oncall): Acknowledged. I'll monitor live metrics for 1h and coordinate a short postmortem. Reopen thread if thresholds hit. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: incident_milestone recorded: mitigations_applied at 2963004750; next_review_at=2963006550
Sahil (oncall): Closing primary action list — all emergency rules are logged and have rollback timers. Will draft a timeline and RCA notes in INC-2963.
